The mass spectrometry shows a molecular ion peak at m/z 127.09971. This suggests a molecular weight of approximately 127 Da. The isotope pattern shows:
- M peak at 127 (100% intensity)
- M+1 at 128 (8.12% intensity)
- M+2 at 129 (0.49% intensity)

The M+1 peak of ~8% suggests the presence of carbon atoms (each carbon contributes ~1.1% to M+1). This indicates approximately 7-8 carbons.

- C7H9NO would be 123.07
- C7H13NO would be 127.10 - this matches!

C7H13NO (127.10) seems most likely. Let me verify the DBE (Double Bond Equivalent):
DBE = (2×7 + 2 - 13 + 1)/2 = (14 + 2 - 13 + 1)/2 = 4/2 = 2

So the molecule has 2 degrees of unsaturation (could be 2 double bonds, 1 ring + 1 double bond, or 2 rings).

Now let me get the 1H NMR to understand the structure better.
